value.subtitle: Piet Mondrian and Theo van Doesburg's search for universal harmony
value.summary: De Stijl reduced art to pure abstraction using only primary colors (red, blue, yellow) alongside black, white, and non-colors constrained within orthogonal horizontal-vertical grids.
value.keyTakeaway: Neoplasticism sought absolute visual equilibrium through extreme geometric reduction.
